sources.mempool.space: https://mempool.space/api (primary: every request below the heading 'primary')

terms_read: mempool.space Terms of Service (updated 2024-07-10; the text of frontend/.../terms-of-service.component.html of github.com/mempool/mempool): no clause forbids the use of the API; no licence for the data is stated; 'no warranty ... verify all data'. blockstream.info: the explorer is Blockstream's; its terms of use (blockstream.com/terms, version 1.0) contain no clause on automated requests or on the data. Neither service states a licence for chain data; the facts are re-derived and cross-checked here.
method: Fixed sampling HEIGHTS (history: every 100,000 blocks from 100,000 to 900,000 with 840,000 added; window: 971,480-971,489). Block facts and the coinbase from both services and compared; all transactions of 840,000 and 971,489 from mempool.space, the first 600 stored, the first 600 and the last page of each fetched from blockstream.info and compared field by field. Statistics computed by sen0401_ch09_census_collect_v1_0_0.py: total fees = coinbase outputs - subsidy (and, for the two full blocks, equal to the sum of the transaction fees: asserted); medianFee_own = round(median of fee / (weight / 4) over all transactions but the coinbase); medianFee = the figure the mempool.space block page prints for the same block (kept because the chapter's research quotes it; it differs from ours because that service uses package-adjusted fee rates).

requests.retry: up to 7 tries, exponential backoff, Retry-After honoured
